title.original: DeFT: Mitigating Data Dependencies for Flexible Communication Scheduling in Distributed Training
title.zh: DeFT：减轻分布式训练中灵活通信调度的数据依赖性
title.en: DeFT: Mitigating Data Dependencies for Flexible Communication Scheduling in Distributed Training

inclusion_reason.zh: DeFT 将依赖分析、背包调度和收敛约束实现为通用通信调度器，可直接嵌入数据并行训练运行时。
inclusion_reason.en: DeFT implements dependency analysis, knapsack scheduling, and convergence constraints as a general communication scheduler that can plug into data-parallel runtimes.

abstract.zh: DeFT 是面向数据并行训练的通信调度器，通过放宽部分数据依赖并把可重叠通信选择转化为多重背包问题，扩大计算—通信重叠窗口。
abstract.en: DeFT is a communication scheduler for data-parallel training that relaxes selected data dependencies and casts overlap selection as multiple knapsack problems to expose more compute-communication concurrency.

problem.zh: 现有调度器受到硬依赖、高覆盖率和张量切分后计算—通信时长失衡的限制，流水线中仍会留下难以填充的气泡。
problem.en: Existing schedulers are constrained by hard dependencies, saturated overlap coverage, and imbalanced tensor compute and communication times, leaving bubbles that simple partitioning or fusion cannot fill.

approach.zh: DeFT 使用延迟更新消除部分硬依赖，通过更新频率和异构链路降低覆盖压力，并以正反向计算时间作为背包容量选择通信任务。
approach.en: DeFT uses delayed updates to remove selected hard dependencies, adjusts update frequency and heterogeneous links to reduce coverage pressure, and packs communication into forward and backward compute windows.

system_design.zh: 调度器分析张量依赖和时长，构造多重背包实例，生成延迟与链路分配计划；收敛损失量化模块约束可采用的调度变化。
system_design.en: The scheduler profiles tensor dependencies and durations, builds knapsack instances, emits delay and link assignments, and uses quantified convergence loss to constrain permissible schedule changes.

key_results.zh: 在所测数据并行工作负载上，DeFT 相比既有通信调度器获得更高训练吞吐，同时未观察到精度损失。
key_results.en: Across the evaluated data-parallel workloads, DeFT improves training throughput over prior communication schedulers without observed accuracy loss.

limitations.zh: 证据来自有限规模的 A100 集群；延迟更新对其他优化器和非平稳负载的收敛影响、以及在线时长估计误差仍需验证。
limitations.en: Evidence comes from a limited A100 cluster; convergence under other optimizers and nonstationary workloads, along with errors in online duration estimates, remains to be tested.

workloads: data-parallel training on three representative benchmarks

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
